items.prompt:
Both stories teach that 'helping others feels good.' They share the same:
A) setting
B) theme
C) author's pet

steps: Same lesson = theme. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Story A is set in a city; Story B in a forest. Their settings are:
A) the same
B) different
C) missing

steps: City vs forest. Key is B.

items.prompt:
The 'lesson' of a story is its:
A) theme
B) setting
C) title

In both stories a character loses something and then finds it. The:
A) themes are different
B) plots are similar
C) settings must match

steps: Same lost-and-found events. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Where and when a story takes place is the:
A) plot
B) setting
C) theme

steps: Setting = place and time. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Story A happens 'long ago'; Story B happens 'today.' This is a difference in:
A) theme
B) setting (time)
C) plot only

steps: Different time setting. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Two stories by the same author both teach 'be brave,' but one is on a mountain and one is at sea. They share a ____ but differ in ____.
A) plot; theme
B) theme; setting
C) setting; theme

steps: Same lesson, different places. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Story A: a girl trains hard and wins a race. Story B: a boy practices and wins a contest. These plots are:
A) completely different
B) similar (work hard, then succeed)
C) the same setting

steps: Same plot pattern. Key is B.
